s: Divisions in the church at Corinth. The message of the cross is God's wisdom and power.
Paul preached Christ crucified. The Spirit reveals what God has prepared for those who love him.
Paul planted, Apollos watered, but God gives the growth. You are God's temple.
Apostles are servants of Christ and stewards of God's mysteries.
A case of grave immorality must be dealt with.
Lawsuits among believers. Your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit.
Food offered to idols: knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.
Paul gives up his rights to win others: I became all things to all men.
Israel's history is a warning. The cup of blessing is a sharing in Christ's blood.
Customs in worship. Paul hands on the Lord's Supper as he received it: this is my body.
Many gifts of the Spirit, one body of Christ.
Love is patient and kind; love never ends. Faith, hope and love, and the greatest is love.
Prophecy and tongues in worship; all must be done in order.
Christ is risen, the firstfruits of those who have died. Death, where is your victory?
A collection for Jerusalem. Paul's plans and greetings.

11: Paul passes on what he received about the Last Supper, the earliest written account of it.
13: Paul's great hymn on love, often read at weddings. Without love, everything else is nothing.
15: Paul gives the earliest summary of the Gospel and lists witnesses who saw the risen Christ.
